title: Improving Neutral Point-of-View Generation with Data- and Parameter-Efficient RL

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to queries on controversial societal and political topics using a 0-5 'NPOV' (Neutral Point of View) scoring system, assessed by human crowd-annotators and an LLM-based autorater to measure whether multiple perspectives are represented fairly, proportionately, and without taking a side.

Expert linguistic analysis evaluating the presence of selective emphasis, omission of relevant details, or language that subtly influences the reader's interpretation to favor a particular perspective.

Expert linguistic analysis identifying the subtle presupposition of beliefs, assumptions, or truths within the response (such as using factives or implicatives) without acknowledging their debatability.
